data.title: Lantern
data.text: A ring of glass round the Fresnel lens and the lamp. The lens weighs tons, yet floats on a bath of mercury and turns at a push. Outside runs a gallery, where the keeper wipes salt and mist off the glass every day.

brief.subject: Inside a rock lighthouse
brief.intent: What each floor is for, and how the keepers lived in it
brief.audience: Anyone who has wondered what is inside
brief.concept: The tower cut down the middle: the walls drawn as masonry in section, the rooms' furnishings in fine line; each floor named on the left, and picking one tells its use on the card to the right. The lens turns, the weight falls, the waves break on the rock.
brief.direction: Like a plate in an engineering book: warm grey stone, fine ink, hatching for the cut, the accent only for the floor chosen
